effects.effect: Whenever you or an [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) creature takes damage from a [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), you can use a [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to guard against the blow. You reduce any damage from the [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) by an amount equal to your level.
